title: Head of Finance, Brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries . Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows.

We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional/global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership

  • Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil’s dynamic economic and regulatory environment.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long-range planning processes for Brazil.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.
  • Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.

Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness

  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD/ECF), and other regulatory submissions.
  • Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high/medium/low risk) within established timelines.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve “audit-ready, always” standards.
  • Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.

Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

  • Own end-to-end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).
  • Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.
  • Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.
  • Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.

Performance Management & Business Partnering

  • Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost-to-serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability

Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management

  • Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.
  • Lead governance of Fixed-asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment)
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.

Systems, ERP & Digital Finance

  • Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
  • Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision-making.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.
  • Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.
  • Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline
  • Foster effective cross-functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.
  • Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.
  • Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.
  • Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.
  • Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP
  • Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision-makers.
  • Strong systems orientation, with hands-on ERP experience (SAP/Oracle) and BI/reporting tools.
  • Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.
  • High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).
  • MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).
  • Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.
  • Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

About Yuna

Yuna is the number one AI for mental health. We provide 24/7 unlimited support for employees worldwide. Specifically, we're focused on the USA market and have large enterprise customers. We need your support rolling out Yuna as a benefit to employees.

We're a remote first venture-backed company. We have a high bar for excellence, move fast, say it like it is, and are mission-driven. We're excited to get to know you and excited to have you join us full-time. If you're the type of person that's excited by a challenge, read on.

About the Role

We’re hiring our first Technical Sales Engineer (Builder) to sit at the intersection of Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Engineering.

This is not a traditional SE role where you just “support” deals. You will ship code, build internal tooling, and design + implement integrations that help enterprises say “yes” faster and successfully onboard after the contract is signed. You’ll own technical solutions end-to-end: discovery, architecture, execution, and operationalization.

You’ll be responsible for deeply understanding Yuna’s B2B onboarding process and then inventing streamlined internal products, improving and replacing existing architecture, and building scalable data flows and security workflows. You’ll work directly with Sales and Customers during technical discovery, run technical evaluations, handle security reviews, and then build what’s needed—often yourself—using a mix of code and low-code (Retool, Zapier/n8n, etc.).

Your main partner will be Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs from pre-sale to post-sale.

This role is critical to helping implementations succeed through real automation, clean systems, and high-quality technical execution.

Details

You will support the full sales engineering, technical onboarding, and post-sale integration across:

Direct Employer Customers (enterprise and mid-market)

Channel Partnerships (PEOs, benefits platforms, brokers, and ecosystem partners)

What You’ll Do

Pre-Sales Technical Leadership (but hands-on)

Own technical discovery: understand customer systems, constraints, and requirements, then design the path to “live.”

Lead technical demos when needed, including custom demos tailored to a prospect’s environment and workflows.

Answer deep technical questions from IT/Security/Engineering stakeholders (architecture, data flows, SSO, SCIM, APIs, logging, privacy).

Drive and complete RFPs, security questionnaires, and IT due diligence efficiently.

Convert messy customer needs into clear technical scopes, integration plans, timelines, and risks.

Build Integrations + Automations (ship PRs)

Build and maintain integrations with HRIS, identity providers, benefits platforms, PEOs, and partner systems.

Implement SSO, directory sync, eligibility file pipelines, provisioning workflows, and monitoring/alerting for integrations.

Ship PRs to production systems to improve onboarding reliability, reduce manual work, and harden security posture.

Create and maintain automations in tools like Zapier or n8n to eliminate repetitive operational tasks and improve data quality.

Build internal tools (Retool or similar) that Customer Success and Sales use daily: enrollment dashboards, integration health checks, rollout trackers, eligibility validation, etc.

Systems Design + Operational Excellence

Design simple, scalable system architecture for onboarding and enterprise operations (data model, workflows, failure modes, retries, observability).

Own the “implementation layer” across tools and services—be the person who understands the whole machine.

Establish repeatable patterns, playbooks, and templates: integration checklists, security artifacts, demo environments, standard configurations.

Create feedback loops: what customers ask for, what breaks, what slows deals, what causes churn—then fix it in the system.

Sales ↔ Customer Success Handoff (clean + technical)

Partner closely with Head of Customer & Partner Success to ensure handoffs are detailed, structured, and actionable.

Document technical requirements, configurations, edge cases, and integration states so post-sale is never guessing.

Support early implementations when the path isn’t obvious and technical judgment is needed.

Reduce friction between what was promised and what’s delivered by shaping scopes and setting expectations early.

Who You Are

You’re a software engineer who also loves the customer-facing problem set.

You can talk to IT teams and also go build the solution the same day.

You’re likely a strong fit if you have

5–10+ years experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Implementation Engineering, or Software Engineering in a customer-facing role.

Strong engineering fundamentals: you can design systems, read/ship production code, and debug real incidents.

Comfort with Python (or similar) for automation, data pipelines, and integration work.

Experience building internal tools and workflows using low-code systems like Retool (or similar), plus the ability to drop into code when needed.

Strong understanding of APIs, data flows, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns (REST, webhooks, SSO/SAML/OIDC, SCIM, ETL, file-based eligibility).

Experience running security reviews and talking confidently about privacy, data handling, encryption, access control, and auditability.

Excellent written communication: you can produce crisp technical docs, scopes, and implementation plans.

High autonomy: you can take a vague outcome and turn it into a working system with minimal oversight.

A bias for action and ownership: you don’t escalate problems, you solve them.

Bonus points if you have experience with

HR tech, benefits platforms, PEO ecosystems, or healthcare-adjacent products.

SOC 2 environments and security/compliance workflows.

HubSpot (including automation/workflows), data hygiene, and CRM-integrated operational tooling.

Event-driven architectures, queueing, retries, and observability (logging/metrics/tracing).

AI or data-heavy products.

What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)

Enterprise deals move faster because technical discovery is crisp and objections get handled with confidence and proof.

Security reviews become repeatable and efficient because artifacts and processes are dialed.

Onboarding becomes more automated and less manual; Customer Success spends time on outcomes, not admin.

Integrations are reliable, monitored, and standardized across customer types (direct + channel).

Sales and Customer Success trust you as an execution partner who unblocks growth and hardens the product.

Perks

Market competitive compensation and opportunity for equity in a fast-growth startup

Remote-first work with flexibility and autonomy

High ownership and the chance to define how this function works

A deeply mission-driven culture focused on real-world impact

Venha fazer parte do nosso time e crescer junto com a gente!

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente. “Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana.

title: Formulation Scientist
description:
Position Summary

The role will provide technical support for local laboratory work, with a primary focus on formulation development to support customer projects, the promotion of Vantage™ products, and customer events. Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.

The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.

Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.

Position Scope

The position will be located in Brasil.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.

Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.

Education & Experience:

Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).

Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.

Knowledge, Skills, & Talents

· Spanish and English speaker.

· Knowledge of development Personal Care products (Formulation & process).

· Being responsible, organized, proactive, problem-solving, easy to work in a team are characteristics inherent to the vacancy profile

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Ability to influence and work in cross functional teams.

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

· Natural collaborator, contributing to a positive team dynamic.

· Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to optimize processes.

Working Conditions

Hybrid model

title: Data Migration Lead
description:
Sobre a Stratesys

A Stratesys é uma consultora multinacional especializada em transformação digital e soluções SAP, com presença consolidada na Europa e na América. É reconhecida como parceiro estratégico da SAP e atua em projetos inovadores para clientes de diversos setores, assegurando excelência tecnológica e qualidade certificada.

Com hubs internacionais e atuação no Brasil, a Stratesys oferece um ambiente colaborativo e multicultural, promove desenvolvimento contínuo e proporciona participação em projetos desafiantes no ecossistema tecnológico. A missão da empresa é conectar talento e tecnologia para impulsionar a transformação digital das organizações.

Principais Atividades

  • Definir e liderar a estratégia de migração de dados end‑to‑end em programas de transformação (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, plataformas cloud/híbridas), incluindo escopo, abordagem, cronograma e governança.
  • Liderar descoberta e avaliação de dados (assessment de qualidade, perfilagem, mapeamento de origem‑destino, regras de negócio e de transformação).
  • Desenhar e supervisionar processos ETL/ELT , data cleansing, deduplicação e reconciliação, assegurando integridade, rastreabilidade e conformidade .
  • Coordenar ondas de migração (mock runs, dress rehearsals, cutover), planos de rollback e critérios de “go/no‑go”, articulando‑se com equipas funcionais, técnicas e de negócio.
  • Definir e manter templates, standards e documentação (DML, DQ rules, mapeamentos, listas de carga, plano de testes), garantindo reusabilidade e consistência.
  • Estabelecer indicadores de qualidade de dados (DQ KPIs), relatórios de progresso e planos de mitigação de risco, comunicando‑os a stakeholders executivos.
  • Orientar equipas de projeto (internas e parceiras), promover melhores práticas e capacitar clientes em processos de migração e governança de dados.

Requisitos Técnicos e Linguísticos

  • Experiência comprovada (sénior) a liderar migrações de dados em programas SAP (ECC/S/4HANA), com histórico de entregas em cutovers complexos .
  • Domínio de mapeamento e transformação de dados (master e transactional), desenho de ETL/ELT e ferramentas de carga (por exemplo: SAP Data Services , SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit , LSMW, Azure/AWS data pipelines ou equivalentes).
  • Conhecimento de qualidade e governança de dados (DQ, MDM/MDG, linagem, reconciliação, conformidade e auditoria).
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e gestão de projetos (planeamento, risco, comunicação executiva).
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderança de equipas e coordenação de múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Bom nível de inglês (valorizado); espanhol é diferencial.
  • Perfil proativo, autónomo, orientado a resultados e ao cliente, com forte capacidade analítica e de comunicação.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

O que oferecemos

✅ Modelo de contratação preferencialmente cooperado , com enquadramento competitivo.

✅ Posição de longo prazo , integrada em programas estratégicos de transformação.

✅ Projetos internacionais e desafiantes no ecossistema SAP.

✅ Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural, com interação constante com equipas globais.

✅ Flexibilidade de trabalho .

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer

Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)

Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)

What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role

This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

A empresa Alpha7 Desenvolvimento de Software referência em soluções de gestão avançada para farmácias, há 15 anos transformando a gestão de farmácias no Brasil, está em busca de um novo talento para o time Comercial.

Chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um Alpha!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Responsável pela primeira etapa do funil de vendas, identificando oportunidades e abrindo portas para o time comercial;
  • Prospecção de Leads, fazer pesquisa e identificar leads em potencial a partir de diversas fontes, como bases de dados, inbound marketing, eventos e redes sociais;
  • Entrar em contato com potenciais clientes via e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp ou outros canais;
  • Personalizar as abordagens com base no perfil do lead e nas dores que ele enfrenta no negócio;
  • Agendamento de Reuniões ou Demonstrações do produto;
  • Manutenção do Pipeline;
  • Atualizar o CRM com informações sobre as interações com cada lead e garantir o acompanhamento adequado.

Requisitos e Conhecimento Técnico:

  • Desejável graduação completa ou cursando em Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em SDR, televendas ou vendas internas;
  • Conhecimentos gerais de técnicas de vendas e qualificação de leads;
  • Vivencia em atendimento ao cliente perfil consultivo;
  • Resiliência de rotinas de contatos e follow-ups;
  • Facilidade em tecnologia (CRM, WhatsApp business, planilhas);
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidades de negociação;
  • Organização e disciplina comercial;

Informações adicionais:

- Modelo de Trabalho: Atuação 100% presencial;

- Regime de contratação: CLT;

- Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 as 17h00.

PERFIL DE VAGA

Consultora Comercial Sênior (vaga exclusiva feminina)

• Gerenciar pipeline de vendas através de CRM, acompanhando indicadores de conversão

• Trabalhar com metas mensais desafiadoras, mantendo foco em crescimento contínuo

Interessada?

Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do time que transforma vidas todos os dias.

title: Assessora de Investimentos JR. - Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres
description:
Sobre nós

Fundada em 1997 na Coreia do Sul e presente em 19 países, a Mirae Asset é um conglomerado financeiro global que oferece soluções de investimento inovadoras para clientes ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, atuamos como corretora de valores, conectando o mercado local a nossa presença internacional e colocando à disposição de investidores pessoas físicas e institucionais produtos e serviços de primeira linha. Nosso compromisso é unir solidez global, inovação e proximidade no atendimento para apoiar nossos clientes em seus objetivos de investimento.

#VemSerMiraeAsset

Assessora de Investimentos Jr (Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres)

Descrição:

Profissional de Assessoria de Investimentos responsável pela gestão e relacionamento de uma carteira de aproximadamente 500 clientes do segmento varejo. Atuação com forte foco no cliente, orientação à performance e atingimento de metas, aliando intensidade comercial à identificação contínua de oportunidades de investimento dentro da base ativa.

Espera-se que o(a) profissional tenha capacidade analítica e comercial para mapear oportunidades de negócios, contribuir para o aumento de volume sob custódia, captação líquida e geração de valor para os clientes e para a companhia.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o relacionamento com uma carteira de cerca de 500 clientes varejo.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o perfil, objetivos e necessidades dos clientes.
  • Identificar oportunidades de investimento e de alocação dentro da base ativa.
  • Realizar ações comerciais recorrentes visando as metas relacionadas a captação.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho da carteira e propor ajustes de acordo com o cenário de mercado.
  • Atuar com foco em metas individuais e coletivas, contribuindo para os resultados da área.
  • Manter registros e interações atualizadas nos sistemas internos (CRM e plataformas).
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com mesas de operações, produtos e demais áreas de suporte.

Requisitos

  • Certificação obrigatória: CPA-20
  • Formação em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em produtos de investimento (renda fixa, renda variável, fundos, etc.).
  • Perfil comercial, com boa comunicação e capacidade de relacionamento.
  • Organização, disciplina e foco em resultados.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em atendimento ao cliente ou área comercial no mercado financeiro.

Diferenciais

  • CEA será um diferencial
  • Experiência prévia com carteira de clientes varejo.
  • Vivência em plataformas digitais de investimentos.
  • Conhecimento de CRM e ferramentas de gestão comercial.

Benefícios: Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação, Assistência Médica, Seguro Vida, Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento, Reembolso idiomas, Reembolso odontológico, Wellhub e PLR.

-Power BI, Power Automate e outras soluções que apoiem a automação e a análise de dados.

-Familiaridade com temas de Inteligência Artificial, incluindo riscos, automação de processos e suporte a iniciativas de Governança de IA.-Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Lean)

title: Motorista de ônibus
description:
Descrição

A Aliança Tur, empresa com mais de 25 anos de experiência no transporte rodoviário de passageiros, certificada pela ISO 9001:2015, está contratando Motorista de Ônibus para atuar em operações de fretamento corporativo em áreas de mineração no estado do Pará.

Buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a segurança, pontualidade e atendimento de qualidade, que contribuam para manter o padrão de excelência que diferencia a Aliança Tur no transporte de colaboradores de grandes empresas do setor mineral.

Responsabilidades
  • Realizar o transporte diário de colaboradores de mineradoras entre unidades operacionais e alojamentos;
  • Conduzir o veículo com segurança, responsabilidade e atenção total às normas de trânsito e de segurança da Vale;
  • Cumprir rigorosamente horários e rotas estabelecidas;
  • Fazer a checagem diária das condições do veículo antes das viagens (óleo, pneus, luzes, freios etc.);
  • Comunicar falhas ou ocorrências ao setor de tráfego/manutenção;
  • Manter o veículo limpo e organizado;
  • Adotar conduta profissional e cordial, representando a empresa junto aos clientes e passageiros;
  • Participar de treinamentos de segurança e reciclagens periódicas exigidas pelas mineradoras.
Qualificações
  • CNH categoria D ou E, com curso de transporte coletivo de passageiros atualizado;
  • Experiência comprovada como motorista de ônibus em fretamento corporativo ou áreas industriais/mineradoras;
  • Conhecimento em direção defensiva e mecânica preventiva básica;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em escala (inclusive noturna, se necessário);
  • Comprometimento com segurança, disciplina e pontualidade;
  • Desejável: experiência prévia em operações Vale.

A Aliança Tur oferece remuneração compatível com o mercado e pacote de benefícios comunicados na entrevista.

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Overview

A US-based financial services organization is seeking an experienced Snowflake Data Engineer to support the ongoing development and optimization of its cloud data platform. This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable ETL pipelines, enforcing strong data governance practices, and preparing the enterprise data warehouse to leverage advanced capabilities such as Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.

This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality, secure, and analytics-ready data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines within Snowflake to support analytics and downstream use cases
  • Develop and maintain scalable data models to support reporting, BI, and advanced AI/ML workloads
  • Implement and enforce data governance best practices, including data quality, lineage, access controls, and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and structure data to enable future adoption of Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence capabilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Monitor and improve performance, cost efficiency, and reliability of the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing across the data engineering function

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience as a Data Engineer working with Snowflake in production environments
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • Experience working in regulated or financial services environments is strongly preferred
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud-based data warehouses

Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Experience with modern data tools such as:
  • dbt
  • Fivetran
  • Matillion
  • Apache Airflow
  • Experience collaborating with data science or AI teams

title: Analista de crédito
description:

Nosso foco é impulsionar o desenvolvimento urbano e gerar oportunidades de investimento seguras e lucrativas para nossos parceiros.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos contratando um Analista de Crédito para integrar a equipe da Rayo Capital. Este cargo é responsável por realizar análises de crédito detalhadas, avaliar riscos e recomendar limites de crédito com base em dados financeiros e tendências de mercado. Outras responsabilidades incluem preparar relatórios financeiros, fornecer suporte analítico para tomada de decisão e interagir com clientes e partes interessadas para discutir avaliações de crédito. Este é um cargo em regime de tempo integral, com modelo de trabalho híbrido em São Paulo, SP, permitindo alguns dias de trabalho remoto.

Qualificações

  • Gestão de Crédito e Avaliação de Crédito: Experiência em gerenciamento e avaliação de crédito, garantindo decisões baseadas em práticas sólidas e éticas.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar dados financeiros e identificar tendências para avaliar riscos e fundamentar recomendações estratégicas.
  • Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e objetiva para colaborar com outras partes da equipe e clientes, facilitando uma tomada de decisão eficaz.
  • Finanças: Conhecimento sólido em práticas financeiras e contábeis para apoiar avaliações e análises no contexto de crédito.
  • Qualificações adicionais desejáveis: formação em administração, economia, contabilidade ou áreas correlatas; familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados; e nível intermediário ou avançado em inglês.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)

$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses

We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.

Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.

What You'll Actually Do

High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.

Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data

Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.

AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.

Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)

Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency

Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback

Why Top Editors Choose Us:

Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.

Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.

See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Tech Lead

Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais que desejam atuar em projetos de inovação, transformação digital e change management, com impacto direto nos resultados da companhia e na experiência dos clientes.

O sucesso nessa função exige visão estratégica de negócio, perfil relacional, resiliência, capacidade de resolução de problemas e sólidos conhecimentos técnicos. Reconhecida na lista da revista Fortune das "Empresas Mais Admiradas do Mundo" de 2024, bem como na lista Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For ® de 2024, a MetLife, por meio de suas subsidiárias e afiliadas, é uma das principais empresas de serviços financeiros do mundo; fornecendo seguros, anuidades, benefícios para funcionários e gestão de ativos para clientes individuais e institucionais. title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for " SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Supervisor(a) Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA)
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor de Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA).

Quais as responsabilidades?

Supervisionar as atividades relacionadas ao abastecimento de matéria prima de todas as unidades do grupo, garantindo a execução eficiente das operações da Torre de Controle CTT e Torre de Manutenção elevando a confiabilidade dos apontamos das classes de manutenção do grupo. Coordenar a equipe de operadores, assegurando que todas as metas de desempenho das áreas sejam alcançadas, realizando o acompanhamento diário das operações e implementando melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior completo em Engenharia Agronômica ou áreas afins;

Experiência em operações CTT e Torre de Manutenção;

Sólida vivência com indicadores de performance das operações e equipamentos;

Desejável conhecimento em sistemas como Simplefarm, Gatec, Solinftec, Logtrac;

Gestão de pessoas.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Corretor de Imóveis Corporativo
description:
Estamos em busca de Consultores Imobiliários Corporativos, com ou sem experiência no mercado.

Resumo do Cargo

Você fará parte de uma equipe selecionada de corretores que atuam nos principais bairros da capital (Vila Olímpia, Itaim Bibi, Faria Lima, Brooklin, Pinheiros, Paulista), com a maior taxa de comissionamento do mercado (até 45%), ajuda de custo e treinamento.   • Negociar condições de compra, venda e locação de imóveis, garantindo a satisfação de todas as partes envolvidas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário e a legislação vigente.
  • Elaborar relatórios e manter registros de negociações e atividades de clientes.

Qualificações

  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita eficientes.
  • Habilidades de negociação.
  • Organização.
  • Competência para realizar análises de mercado.
  • Proatividade.
  • Entender as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas.
  • Ser persuasivo.
